name: Transforming a Residential Chalet
notes: Sheet 0 (Estudio Nájera y Boto Interiorismo, a chalet renovated in Lardero, La Rioja): a suburban house of two storeys among identical neighbours, white party walls either side; the ground floor is brick-and-timber-faced piers between sliding glass screens, opening to a timber-tile terrace and a long turquoise pool, the first floor a white box that cantilevers a metre and a half over it with a recessed glazed bay and a glass-balustraded terrace, a timber panel inset in its face; at the street a long white wall with a black panelled gate under a white lintel and pergola. Modelled: the house, the box and its cantilever, the glass balustrade, the terrace and pool, the street wall and gate, the neighbours' walls and flanking boxes, a bare street tree. Interiors (open living-dining kitchen, large-format ceramic headboards, the hall, sheet 0) not modelled. Guessed: every dimension (plot 26 x 24 m), the neighbours' heights. A private home placed at its town only (Lardero).
